quiz_mapping.source_question: You run one training script two times and get a different test score each time. Which change makes the train and test split the same in every run?
quiz_mapping.Chinese_criteria: 固定输入顺序/同实现与配置下，私有Random42使shuffle可复现；不是换tuple或扩大test使随机消失。
Study_files: 数据科学基础/12-数据版本缓存与流式处理.md

quiz_mapping.source_question: What does a call to a generator function return?
quiz_mapping.Chinese_criteria: 生成器对象，函数体按next推进；调用表达式求值和外层iter本身仍可能有行为。

quiz_mapping.source_question: The call batches(range(10), 4) uses the default drop_last=False. Which batch sizes does it give?
quiz_mapping.Chinese_criteria: 10条按4分批得到4/4/2，droplast为True时去末2；空输入0批。

quiz_mapping.source_question: Why is a pure-Python dot product over a million floats much slower than the NumPy dot product?
quiz_mapping.Chinese_criteria: 同为有限数值且合同等价时，逐元素解释/对象开销常更高；NumPy原生dtype与编译实现、布局/硬件/线程决定实际速度，不套固定毫秒。
Study_files: Python/实践/02-调试日志与性能定位.md

quiz_mapping.source_question: The function def add(item, bucket=[]) appends item to bucket and returns bucket. You call add(1) and then add(2). What does the second call return?
quiz_mapping.Chinese_criteria: 默认列表在def时建一次，第二次调用得到1/2；None+内部新建避免跨调用共享。

quiz_mapping.source_question: You standardize the features before you train a model. Where must the means and standard deviations come from?
quiz_mapping.Chinese_criteria: 只在训练split拟合均值/标准差，再用于验证/测试；不拿全部数据或各testbatch另fit。
Study_files: 数据科学基础/12-数据版本缓存与流式处理.md

practice_mapping.Chinese: 相同n/testfraction与合同下只改seed：尺寸不变、数据/切分成员及模型评价可变；不复刻源run_demo，实际数据分布也影响指标。
Study: 数据科学基础/12-数据版本缓存与流式处理.md

professional_corrections: frozen浅限制不等深不可变/可哈希/运行时type验证；默认factory逐实例分配与普通默认参数定义时分配分开
生成器调用延迟运行、外层精确size/bool校验、尾批/耗尽/epoch工厂、文件所有权与上游内存分开
JSON根/重复字段/CSV表头/显式特征次序与转换政策；int1.9/True不作为合法离散标签保证；源load弱形状/finite/ragged/empty问题不当正式加载器

图是8行vs2行SMIL固定展示，不运行文件、测RSS或训练；列表8+float24是特定CPython估例，NumPy布局/dtype及输出分配不一律零拷贝
benchmark各变体在错shape契约不同，best不是线上latency分布；tracemalloc不是所有C/GPU/RSS；作者0.86/.89与速度/内存原记录未复跑或作泛化保证
